verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Al-hamdu Lillaahi faatiris-samaawaati wal-ardi jaa'ilil-malaa'ikati rusulan ulee ajnihatin mathnaa wa thulaatha wa rubaa'a yazeedu fil-khalqi maa yashaa'u innallaaha alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Maa yaftahi Allaahu lin-naasi min rahmatin falaa mumsika lahaa wa maa yumsik falaa mursila lahu min ba'dihi wa huwal-azeezul-hakeem
Yaa ayyuhan-naasu udhkuroo ni'matallaahi alaykum hal min khaaliqin ghayru Allaahi yarzuqukum minas-samaa'i wal-ardi laa ilaaha illaa huwa fa-annaa tu'ufakoon
Wa in yukadhdhibooka faqad kudhdhibat rusulun min qablika wa ilaa Allaahi turja'ul-umoor
Yaa ayyuhan-naasu inna wa'da Allaahi haqqun falaa taghurrannakumul-hayaa utud-dunyaa wa laa yaghurrannakum Billaahil-gharoor
Innash-shaytaana lakum aduwwun fattakhidhoohu aduwwan innamaa yad'oo hizbahu liyakoonoo min ashaabis-sa'eer
Al-ladheena kafaroo lahum adhaabun shadeedun wal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati lahum maghfiratun wa ajrun kabeer
Afaman zuyyina lahu soo'u amalihi fara'aahu hasanan fa-innallaaha yudillu man yashaa'u wa yahdee man yashaa'u falaa tadhhab nafsuka alayhim hasaraatin innallaaha aleemun bimaa yasna'oon
Wallaahul-ladhee arsalar-riyaaha fatutheeru sahaaban fasuqnaahu ilaa baladin mayyitin fa-ahyaynaa bihil-arda ba'da mawtihaa kadhaalikan-nushoor

Man kaana yureedul-izzata falillaahil-izzatu jamee'an ilayhi yas'adul-kalimut-tayyibu wal-amalus-saalihu yarfa'uhu wal-ladheena yamkuroonas-sayyi'aati lahum adhaabun shadeedun wa makru ulaa'ika huwa yaboor

Wallaahu khalaqakum min turaabin thumma min nutfatin thumma ja'alakum azwaajan wa maa tahmilu min unthaa wa laa tada'u illaa bi-ilmihi wa maa yu'ammaru min mu'ammarin wa laa yunqasu min umurihi illaa fee kitaabin inna dhaalika alaa Allaahi yaseer

Wa maa yastawil-bahraani haadhaa adhbun furaatun saa'ighun sharaabuhu wa haadhaa milhun ujaajun wa min kullin ta'kuloona lahman tariyyan wa tastakhrijoona hilyatan talbasoonahaa wa taral-fulka feehi mawaakhira litabtaghoo min fadlihi wa la-allakum tashkuroon

Yoolijul-layla fin-nahaari wa yoolijun-nahaara fil-layli wa sakhkharash-shamsa wal-qamara kullun yajree li'jalin musamman dhalikumu Allaahu rabbukum lahul-mulku wal-ladheena tad'oona min doonihi maa yamlikoona min qitmeer
In tad'oohum laa yasma'oo du'aa'akum wa law sami'oo mas-tajaaboo lakum wa yawmal-qiyaamati yakfuroona bishirkikum wa laa yunabbi'uka mithlu khabeer
Yaa ayyuhan-naasu antumul-fuqaraa'u ilaa Allaahi Wallaahu huwal-ghaniyyul-hameed
In yasha yudhhibkum wa ya'ti bikhalqin jadeed
Wa maa dhaalika alaa Allaahi bi-azeez

Wa laa taziru waaziratun wizra ukhraa wa in tad'u muthqalatun ilaa himlihaa laa yuhmal minhu shay'un wa law kaana dhaa qurbaa innamaa tundhirul-ladheena yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi wa aqaamus-salaata wa man tazakkaa fa-innamaa yatazakkaa linafsihi wa ilaa Allaahil-maseer
Wa maa yastawil-a'maa wal-baseer
Wa laz-zulumaatu wa lan-noor
Wa laz-zillu wa lal-haroor
Wa maa yastawil-ahyaa'u wa lal-amwaatu innallaaha yusmi'u man yashaa'u wa maa anta bimusmi'in man fil-quboor
In anta illaa nadheer
Innaa arsalnaaka bil-haqqi basheeran wa nadheeran wa in min ummatin illaa khalaa feehaa nadheer
Wa in yukadhdhibooka faqad kadhdhabal-ladheena min qablihim jaa'athum rusuluhum bil-bayyinaati wa biz-zuburi wa bil-kitaabil-muneer
Thumma akhadhtul-ladheena kafaroo fakayfa kaana nakeer
Alam taraa annallaaha anzala minas-samaa'i maa'an fa-akhrajnaa bihi thamaraatin mukhtalifan alwaanuhaa wa minal-jibaali judadun beedun wa humrun mukhtalifun alwaanuhaa wa gharaabeebu sood
Wa minan-naasi wad-dawaabbi wal-an'aam mukhtalifun alwaanuhu kadhaalika innamaa yakhshaa Allaaha min ibaadihil-ulamaa'u innallaaha azeezun ghafoor
Innal-ladheena yatloona kitaaba Allaahi wa aqaamus-salaata wa anfaqoo mimmaa razaqnaahum sirran wa alaaniyatan yarjoona tijaaratan lan taboor
Liyuwaffiyahum ujoorahum wa yazeedahum min fadlihi innahu ghafoorun shakoor
Wal-ladhee awhaynaa ilayka minal-kitaabi huwal-haqqu musaddiqan limaa bayna yadayhi innallaaha bi-ibaadihi lakhabeerun baseer
Thumma awrathnal-kitaabal-ladheena istafaynaa min ibaadinaa faminhum zaalimun linafsihi wa minhum muqtasidun wa minhum saabiqun bil-khayraati bi-idhni Allaahi dhaalika huwal-fadlul-kabeer
Jannaatu adnin yadkhuloonahaa yuhallawna feehaa min asaawira min dhahabin wa lu'ulu'uan wa libaasuhum feehaa hareer
Wa qaalul-hamdu Lillaahil-ladhee adhhaba annal-hazana inna rabbanaa laghafoorun shakoor
Al-ladhee ahallanaa daaral-muqaamati min fadlihi laa yamassunaa feehaa nasabun wa laa yamassunaa feehaa lughoob
Wal-ladheena kafaroo lahum naaru jahannama laa yuqdaa alayhim fayamootoo wa laa yukhaffafu anhum min adhaabihaa kadhaalika najzee kulla kafoor

Wa hum yastarikhoona feehaa rabbanaa akhrijnaa na'mal saalihan ghayral-ladhee kunnaa na'malu awalam nu'ammirkum maa yatadhakkaru feehi man tadhakkara wa jaa'akumun-nadheeru fadhooqoo famaa liz-zaalimeena min naseer
Innallaaha aalimu ghaybis-samaawaati wal-ardi innahu aleemun bidhaatis-sudoor
Huwal-ladhee ja'alakum khalaa'ifa fil-ardi faman kafara fa-alayhi kufruhu wa laa yazeedul-kaafireena kufruhum inda rabbihim illaa maqtan wa laa yazeedul-kaafireena kufruhum illaa khasaaraa

Qul ara'aytum shurakaa'akumul-ladheena tad'oona min doonillaahi aroonee maadhaa khalaqoo minal-ardi am lahum shirkun fis-samaawaati am aataynaahum kitaaban fahum alaa bayyinatin minhu bal in ya'iduz-zaalimoona ba'duhum ba'dan illaa ghurooraa
Innallaaha yumsikus-samaawaati wal-arda an tazoolaa wa la-in zaalataa in amsakahumaa min ahadin min ba'dihi innahu kaana haleeman ghafooraa
Wa aqsamoo Billaahi jahda aymaanihim la-in jaa'ahum nadheerun layakoonunna ahdaa min ihdal-umami falammaa jaa'ahum nadheerun maa zaadahum illaa nufooraa

Istikbaaran fil-ardi wa makras-sayyi'i wa laa yaheequl-makrus-sayyi'u illaa bi-ahlihi fahal yanzuroona illaa sunnatal-awwaleena falan tajida lisunnati Allaahi tabdeelan wa lan tajida lisunnati Allaahi tahweelaa

Awalam yaseeroo fil-ardi fayanzuroo kayfa kaana aaqibatul-ladheena min qablihim wa kaanoo ashadda minhum quwwatan wa maa kaana Allaahu liyu'jizahu min shay'in fis-samaawaati wa laa fil-ardi innahu kaana aleeman qadeeraa
Wa law yu'uaakhidhu Allaahun-naasa bimaa kasaboo maa taraka alaa zahrihaa min daabbatin wa laakin yu'uakhkhiruhum ilaa ajalin musamman fa-idhaa jaa'a ajaluhum fa-innallaaha kaana bi-ibaadihi baseeraa
